verdict.rationale: Digits' own materials repeatedly claim automated, real-time reconciliation that starts before month-end. They also describe surfacing exceptions with context, transaction flagging with smart reviews, and deduplicated entries, so the core idea of reconciliation with exceptions surfaced for review is present. None of it describes a per-bank-account reconciliation against the ledger with explicit matched, unmatched and duplicate views for the accountant to review. Missing for 10: documented per-account bank-to-ledger reconciliation workflow, explicit matched/unmatched/duplicate review queues, independent or hands-on corroboration.
